witness.quote: Any lighted headlamps upon a parked vehicle shall be depressed or dimmed.
witness.reason: Parking at a curb on a sloped road permits concurrence of statutory parking and lighted headlamps.
required_context: Establish a qualifying vehicle and actual parking rather than temporary loading or unloading.

Establish actual standing and parking rather than temporary standing for and while actually loading or unloading merchandise or passengers; record passenger receiving or discharging context where relevant.
Establish vehicle classification and the stated exclusions, retaining the unresolved incorporated NRS 482.029 reference.
Preserve 'depressed or dimmed' without a numerical threshold or an assumed equivalence to a generic low-beam state.
Provide lighted headlamps with observable beam elevation and intensity.
Realize sloped-road and curb geometry, parking approach and footprint, vehicle orientation and load.
Record time-aligned headlamp illumination, beam elevation and intensity or dimming observations throughout parking.
Retain vehicle orientation, road slope and loading as physical context.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor_vehicle_driver can park a qualifying vehicle whose lighted headlamps are the express equipment subject.

targeted_requirements.rationale: Retain raw beam-aim and dimming observations without equating a low-beam flag with the statutory alternatives.
